description: Send the share link to Vari8ion as a request. The one share link is all that is needed. Extra links and folder paths are optional. It can be sent once for each link_id.

extra_links.description: Optional. More share links for the same project, such as a second folder in another cloud.

share_link.description: The main share link the client copied, from OneDrive, SharePoint, Google Drive or Dropbox.
